name: FarmLink — PCL-6 Prototype
description: Prototype agricultural marketplace connecting farmers and vendors through crop and product listings.
summary: Separate farmer and vendor interfaces connect to an Express API for registration, login, listing creation, browsing, and owner-restricted deletion. Repository setup is incomplete: no database schema or setup guide is included.
architecture: A Node.js/Express server serves static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript interfaces and exposes PostgreSQL-backed authentication and listing endpoints. bcrypt hashes registration passwords; JSON Web Tokens identify users for listing creation and ownership checks on deletion. PostgreSQL is configured through DATABASE_URL. This prototype requires an externally provisioned schema and further security hardening before deployment.

capabilities.name: Account registration and login
capabilities.description: Hash registration passwords, verify login credentials, and issue bearer tokens.

capabilities.name: Crop and product listings
capabilities.description: Browse and create agricultural listings through farmer and vendor interfaces.

capabilities.name: Owner-restricted deletion
capabilities.description: Restrict deletion to listings associated with the authenticated user’s phone number.

stack.usage: Runs the marketplace HTTP server and asynchronous database calls.
Serves public interfaces, parses JSON, and exposes authentication, crop, and product endpoints.
Browser scripts connect dashboard actions to the marketplace API.
Provides login, registration, and dedicated farmer/vendor dashboard layouts.
The pg connection pool executes parameterized queries against users, crops, and products tables supplied externally.
Hashes registration passwords with 12 rounds and compares submitted login passwords.
Signs login tokens and verifies bearer tokens before listing creation and owner-restricted deletion.

architectureConnections.description: Marketplace handlers query persisted accounts and listings.
Registration and login handlers hash and verify passwords.
Protected listing handlers verify bearer tokens.

evidence.notes: Reviewed implementation files and repository structure during the repository audit. Only implemented behavior is recorded; availability does not imply production readiness.
